title: Representation Alignment from a Few Paired Data via Distilled Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2610.12781v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aligning two independently pretrained unimodal encoders typically demands millions of paired examples. In this paper, we study the regime where only $N \sim 100$--$500$ pairs are available, while unpaired data on either side is abundant. Our method expresses every representation by its similarities to the $N$ paired anchors, which places both modalities in a common coordinate system; matches the two point clouds with a single entropic optimal transport problem solved over the entire pool, whose marginal constraints counteract the hubness that defeats nearest-neighbor matching; and distills the resulting plan into two lightweight encoders, so that the correspondence becomes inductive. We additionally put this marginal constraint in relation with the one-step hub corrections of the bilingual lexicon induction literature. translated_title: 通过蒸馏最优传输从少量配对数据实现表示对齐
translated_abstract: 对齐两个独立预训练的单模态编码器通常需要数百万个配对样本。本文研究了仅有约100至500对配对样本可用、而两侧均有大量非配对数据的情形。我们的方法通过每个表示与N个配对锚点的相似度来表达该表示，从而将两种模态置于一个共同的坐标系中；然后在整个数据池上求解单个熵正则化最优传输问题来匹配两个点云，其边际约束能够抵消导致最近邻匹配失效的枢纽性问题；最后将所得的传输方案蒸馏到两个轻量级编码器中，使对应关系具备归纳泛化能力。此外，我们将该边际约束与双语词典归纳文献中的单步枢纽校正方法建立了联系。配对数据仅锚点需要：非配对数据集合可以从两个边际分布中独立采样，因此……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于蒸馏最优传输的方法，仅利用约100-500个配对锚点样本即可对齐两个独立预训练的单模态编码器：通过锚点相似度构建共同坐标系，用熵最优传输的边际约束对抗枢纽性问题，并将传输方案蒸馏到轻量级编码器中实现可归纳的跨模态对应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a distilled optimal transport method that aligns two independently pretrained unimodal encoders using only ~100-500 paired anchor samples, by building a common coordinate system from anchor similarities, counteracting hubness via entropic OT marginal constraints, and distilling the transport plan into lightweight encoders for inductive cross-modal correspondence.
